title: Zhenzhen Nanwei
synopsis:
Unexpectedly transported to the game world, Li Zhenzhen became the most popular junior disciple in the immortal sect, Luxian Peak. She initially thought it was a typical cultivation game, diligently completing quests to increase her favorability, practicing swordsmanship with her arrogant and handsome junior brother, having late-night heart-to-heart talks with her gentle and beautiful senior sister, and helping her fellow disciples solve their problems… But she never imagined that the consequences of overdoing it with increasing favorability would be so severe!

(Source: Mango TV, translated)
